Full details: Linked Issues check
**Explanation** Issue `#56507` requires GitOps to fail when the same Fleet-maintained app slug appears twice under software.fleet_maintained_apps, with an error that names the duplicate. The head adds a check in parseSoftware (pkg/spec/gitops.go) that runs getDuplicateNames on the resolved FleetMaintainedApps slice after the inline and path:/paths: entries are appended. On duplicates it appends fmt.Errorf("duplicate fleet_maintained_apps slugs: %v", duplicates) to multiError. This matches the style of the existing label, policy, report, and patch-policy duplicate checks the issue cites. Because the check runs on the resolved list, duplicates that come from included files are also caught, as the issue requests. The added test TestSoftwareDisplayNameValidation/fleet_maintained_app_duplicate_slug (pkg/spec/gitops_test.go) parses the issue's maccy/darwin YAML through GitOpsFromFile and asserts the error text. The dry-run and real-run paths both use this parser, so the error applies to both. Limits: the test covers only inline duplicates, not duplicates split across path:/paths: files. That case is covered by the code path but not by a test. The author states the test failed before the change; this review did not re-run it.
